title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
abstract: arXiv:2609.36471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages. Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. translated_title: 阶梯策略：基于大动作块的世界-动作模型流式推理
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过将动作生成条件化于预测的未来观测来提升机器人操作能力，但未来预测为本已昂贵的迭代式动作生成增加了额外的推理开销。动作分块可以将这一成本摊销到多个动作上，然而由于后续动作仍然条件化于过时的观测，性能在长执行时域内会下降。我们提出了 STAIRCASE POLICY（阶梯策略），这是一个流式推理与训练框架，它将流匹配的 VLA 转变为 JEPA 风格的 WAM，并将大动作块在交错的去噪阶段划分为子块。近期动作一旦可用便立即执行，而后续动作则继续被优化。在每个子块边界处，从最新观测重新预测未来潜在表示，并用其更新所有未执行的动作，从而无需重复完整的策略推理即可实现长时域执行。
tldr: 提出阶梯策略（Staircase Policy）流式推理与训练框架，将大动作块在交错的去噪阶段拆分为子块，并利用基于最新观测重新预测的未来潜在表示持续更新未执行动作，使世界-动作模型无需重复完整推理即可实现长时域高性能执行。
en_tdlr: Staircase Policy is a streaming inference and training framework that partitions large action chunks into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages and continually refines unexecuted actions using future latents re-predicted from the latest observation, enabling long-horizon World-Action Model execution without repeated full policy inference.
